questions.question: Which of the following poets was inspired by nature?
questions.explanation: British poets, including William Wordsworth, were inspired by nature.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 4: A modern, thriving society

learning.why_correct_en: British poets, including William Wordsworth, were inspired by nature.
learning.why_correct_zh:
William Wordsworth 深受自然景色启发。他那首通常被称为《Daffodils》的诗，正式标题是《I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud》。其中最著名的几句是：

“I wandered lonely as a cloud ...
A host, of golden daffodils;
And then my heart with pleasure fills,
And dances with the daffodils.”

水仙花的自然景象即使在诗人独处室内时，仍能通过回忆给他带来快乐。
